title: Healthy Choices at Panera Bread: Dining Debunked! Mind Over Munch
description: How to eat healthy at Panera Bread! First episode of our new series: Dining Debunked! Healthy fast food choices can be tough to make. Let's go through the Panera Bread menu together to learn how to make healthy choices! Remember, this is NOT a video telling you what to eat or avoid, it is simply for educational purposes to help people learn to make informed decisions. This is not a sponsored video.  SUBSCRIBE for new videos every Monday and Thursday!: http://bit.ly/MindOverMunch  Panera's Nutrition PDF: https://www.panerabread.com/content/dam/panerabread/documents/nutrition/Panera-Nutrition.pdf  Panera's Website: http://www.panerabread.com  Check out my How To Choose Bread video: https://youtu.be/qIwXFBh3hjg?list=PLt2c0hX1aB8qk0KNM77ijBHuiEv02R5Ua  Check out my Healthy Fast Food video: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D8YbqA2BSbw&list=PLt2c0hX1aB8rrG6mquNhyCzU-8SiHKc5m  Check out Summer Sips: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewnDoQgkPxA&list=PLt2c0hX1aB8rC-dn_YjAMIUHd_D3vBcgZ  Sodium info from the American Heart Association: http://www.heart.org/HEARTORG/GettingHealthy/NutritionCenter/HealthyEating/Too-Much-Sodium-Infographic_UCM_454468_SubHomePage.jsp  Fat recommendations from the USDA: http://health.gov/dietaryguidelines/dga2010/dietaryguidelines2010.pdf   More Mind Over Munch! Instagram: http://instagram.com/alyssiasheikh eBooks: http://www.mindovermunch.com/ebooks YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/MindOverMunch Twitter: https://twitter.com/MindOverMunch Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mindovermunch Pinterest: http://www.pinterest.com/mindovermunch/ Website: http://www.mindovermunch.com  The information provided on this channel is for informational and educational purposes only and is not intended as a substitute for advice from your physician or other health care professional. You should not use the information on this channel for diagnosis or treatment of any health problem or for prescription of any medication or other treatment. Consult with a healthcare professional before starting any diet, exercise or supplementation program, before taking any medication, or if you suspect you might have a health problem.
